source_statement: [7] Let ABC be a triangle with BC = 2007, CA = 2008, AB = 2009. Let ω be an excircle of ABC that touches the line segment BC at D, and touches extensions of lines AC and AB at E and F , respectively (so that C lies on segment AE and B lies on segment AF ). Let O be the center of ω. Let ` be the line through O perpendicular to AD. Let ` meet line EF at G. Compute the length DG.
